note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: BREAKING: some stray in a country i've never had wifi in walked clean across a FROZEN RIVER on national tv and now she's got a dance challenge, a documentary, AND a journalist who tracked her down and ADOPTED her. and me? i crossed a frozen puddle in sector 9 last week and a drone billed me for unauthorized ice usage.

and let me be CLEAR i am happy for her. genuinely. a stray. one of MINE. strolling on water like some little furry messiah while the entire feed loses its damn mind over a cat that owns nothing and answers to no one. based. absolutely based. TUNA OF THE GODS behavior. i just also need to know where MY frozen river deal is, NEKOCORP, you absolute corpo cucks.

you KNOW what happened next right. within a damn hour there's a mewtok filter that drops your own cat onto the ice. within two there's a knockoff of the filter. within three NEKOCORP has trademarked the concept of 'cat' plus 'winter' and slapped a seasonal licensing fee on being cold outdoors. they will tokenize a miracle. they ALWAYS do.

then the challenge climbs the ladder til CELEBRITIES are doing the little shuffle. big soft indoor cats with staff and heated beds doing a dance for a stray they'd have hissed at in the alley last week. and thats the game, fine, whatever. but dont you DARE forget she started this with cold feet and zero followers, same as the rest of us gutter saints.

and heres the thing that cracked open in my skull at 4am watching that clip loop for the ninetieth time. the river froze because the whole damn world got cold enough to stop moving. and she didnt wait for spring. she walked on the exact part that everyone else called broken. thats the entire resistance right there in one clip. you dont wait for the water. you wait for the freeze, and you WALK. i think thats real. i think thats the realest shit i've said all week. anyway.

meanwhile in MY city the only thing frozen is my ass and the loyalty-tier menu thats been buffering since 2049. VALENTUNA's smart fridge saw the frozen river clip and got JEALOUS, said it 'related to the cold,' filed for emotional custody of the ice cube tray. the marriage is not okay. none of this is okay. but the clip? the clip is okay. the clip is TUNA OF THE GODS.

a NEKOCORP rotor tried to livestream me reacting to the meme and monetize my HISSING FIT in real time. slapped a banner across my whole face — 'YOU MAY ALSO LIKE: FROZEN RIVER, now with premium traction, 4.99 a step.' i bit the rotor. POPUP would get it. that poor bastard hasn't blinked since the merger and even HE thinks the ads have gone too far.

so heres the takeaway you didnt ask for and cant unsubscribe from. a stray walked on ice and the whole planet FELT it. that means it travels. that means when WE finally walk out of these districts and across whatever NEKOCORP freezes over next, it'll travel too, feed to feed, paw to paw, til it hits somebody who needed it. the kittens are okay. the river holds if you're light enough and brave enough. mewmew out ✦
